# V2.3 acceptance evidence

This file records release evidence, not aspirational support. A CI automated compile
does not substitute for the human visual gate required by `finalize_qa.py`.

## Frozen support boundary

- Verified fixture version: MinerU `3.4.4`
- Accepted backend: stable 3.x `_backend: "pipeline"`
- Accepted structured input: legacy flat `*_content_list.json` plus matching
  `*_middle.json` and hash-equal `*_origin.pdf`
- Rejected: VLM, hybrid, office, prereleases, other major versions,
  `content_list_v2.json`-only, and 4.x `structured_content.json`
- Import behavior: consumes only frozen output; never installs/runs MinerU or downloads
  a model
- Official schema reference reviewed 2026-08-14:
  <https://opendatalab.github.io/MinerU/reference/output_files/>
- Official 3.4.4 release reviewed 2026-08-14:
  <https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU/releases/tag/mineru-3.4.4-released>
- Current MinerU license reviewed 2026-08-14:
  <https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU/blob/master/LICENSE.md>

## Public fixture

`tests/fixtures/mineru/pipeline-3.4.4/` is original synthetic repository material.
`fixture-manifest.json` freezes its schema source, file hashes, expected item/node/
disposition counts, and normalized contract hash. `../generate_fixtures.py` recreates
the native source/origin PDF deterministically from the committed synthetic content.
No paper, lecture, MinerU program output, model, or weight is committed.

The native fixture has 22 content items and 31 normalized nodes. Its real Poppler
source audit reaches five-gram coverage `0.9825` against the unchanged `0.95` gate.
The scan fixture is expected to stop at `manual_source_review_required`.

## Required test commands

```text
python scripts/self_test.py
python scripts/v23_profile_test.py
python scripts/v23_mineru_test.py
python scripts/v23_ir_source_test.py
python scripts/v23_output_test.py
python scripts/v23_docx_test.py
python scripts/v23_visual_gate_test.py
python scripts/pipeline.py validate-profile assignment-en-zh
python scripts/pipeline.py validate-profile academic-paper-en-zh
python scripts/pipeline.py validate-profile lecture-notes-en-zh
```

The GitHub `automated-forward` job additionally installs Pandoc, LibreOffice Writer,
Fontconfig, Noto CJK/core fonts, and Poppler. It runs both new Profiles through frozen
import, independent source audit, deterministic synthetic translations, output audit,
DOCX build/audit, LibreOffice PDF conversion, full render decode, CJK/font/A4 checks,
and contact-sheet creation. It must also prove that finalization remains blocked until
a human visual review is recorded.

## Visual-defect closure

The first automated artifact passed machine gates but failed the required human review:
table HTML appeared literally, two references collapsed into one line, and lecture
definition/theorem/proof/example anchors lacked distinct callouts. The fixes added native
Pandoc/Word tables, list-preserving output and PDF audit candidates, source-only byline
classification, and scoped anchor-only callouts with non-absorption failure tests.

Three subsequent failed CI runs were retained as useful evidence rather than rerun away:

- [31783926253](https://github.com/littlemuu/make-bilingual-study-pdf/actions/runs/31783926253):
  exposed Pandoc splitting ordinary raw HTML into multiple AST blocks
- [31784210653](https://github.com/littlemuu/make-bilingual-study-pdf/actions/runs/31784210653):
  exposed the absence of host-template `Table Grid` on Linux
- [31784411191](https://github.com/littlemuu/make-bilingual-study-pdf/actions/runs/31784411191):
  reached PDF and exposed LibreOffice's extracted bullet character in reference auditing

The passing run above verifies all three defects through the real Linux DOCX/PDF chain.
